issues.description: Missing error handling middleware for the Express application
issues.suggestion: Add a global error handler middleware after all routes: app.use((err, req, res, next) => { logger.error(err); res.status(500).json({ error: 'Internal server error' }); });

issues.description: No rate limiting on API endpoints, vulnerable to DoS attacks
issues.suggestion: Implement rate limiting using express-rate-limit: const limiter = rateLimit({ windowMs: 15 * 60 * 1000, max: 100 }); app.use('/todos', limiter);

issues.description: Missing input size limit on JSON payloads, vulnerable to payload attacks
issues.suggestion: Add payload size limit: app.use(express.json({ limit: '10kb' }));
Add helmet middleware for security headers: import helmet from 'helmet'; app.use(helmet());

issues.description: No CORS policy defined, potentially allowing unauthorized cross-origin requests
issues.suggestion: Add CORS middleware with explicit origins: import cors from 'cors'; app.use(cors({ origin: process.env.ALLOWED_ORIGINS?.split(',') || ['http://localhost:3000'] }));

issues.description: No validation that req.params.id is a valid number before conversion
issues.suggestion: Validate ID parameter: const id = Number(req.params.id); if (isNaN(id) || id <= 0) return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Invalid ID' });

issues.description: Same issue as line 23 - no validation of ID parameter
issues.suggestion: Validate ID parameter: const id = Number(req.params.id); if (isNaN(id) || id <= 0) return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Invalid ID' });

issues.description: No try-catch wrapper around route handlers - errors in listTodos() will crash the server
issues.suggestion: Wrap async logic in try-catch or use an asyncHandler wrapper: app.get('/todos', asyncHandler(async (req, res) => { res.json(listTodos()); }));

issues.description: Missing req.body validation - no check if text property exists
issues.suggestion: Add explicit check: if (!req.body || text === undefined) return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Missing text field' });

issues.description: Server starts immediately without graceful shutdown handling
issues.suggestion: Add graceful shutdown: const server = app.listen(PORT, ...); process.on('SIGTERM', () => { server.close(() => { console.log('Server closed'); process.exit(0); }); });

issues.description: Static file serving without path restrictions could expose sensitive files
issues.suggestion: Add explicit options to express.static: app.use(express.static('public', { dotfiles: 'deny', index: false }));

issues.description: Inconsistent error message format between endpoints ('not found' vs specific error messages)
issues.suggestion: Standardize error responses using a consistent format: { error: 'Todo not found' } or create an error response helper function.

issues.description: Console.log used for logging instead of a proper logging library
issues.suggestion: Use a structured logger like winston or pino for production-ready logging with log levels and formatting.

issues.description: Trimming text in the route handler rather than in validation/sanitization layer
issues.suggestion: Move text trimming to the validation function or create a separate sanitization step for better separation of concerns.

codeQuality.summary: The code is functional and reasonably structured but has significant security vulnerabilities including missing rate limiting, no payload size limits, lack of input validation for ID parameters, and no error handling middleware. The application is vulnerable to DoS attacks and may crash on unhandled errors. Adding security middleware (helmet, rate limiting, CORS), input validation, and proper error handling would significantly improve production readiness.

testCoverage.summary: The src/server.js file has no test coverage. All four API endpoints (GET, POST, PATCH, DELETE) lack tests for both success and error paths. Critical gaps include validation error handling, 404 responses, status code verification, and edge cases like invalid ID formats and malformed requests. A comprehensive test suite using supertest or similar HTTP testing library is urgently needed.

suggestions.description: Extract validation and error response logic into a reusable middleware function
suggestions.benefits: Improves testability by isolating validation logic, makes the route handler cleaner and focused on a single responsibility, and allows reuse of validation middleware if additional todo-creation endpoints are added

suggestions.description: Extract ID parsing and validation into a reusable parameter handler or middleware
suggestions.benefits: Eliminates duplicate ID parsing logic, adds validation for invalid IDs (NaN, negative numbers), improves consistency across endpoints, and makes handlers more focused on business logic

suggestions.description: Standardize error response format by using consistent error messages
suggestions.benefits: Improves user experience with more descriptive error messages, maintains consistency with API error reporting patterns, and makes debugging easier by clarifying what resource was not found

suggestions.description: Extract route handlers into separate controller functions for better organization and testability
suggestions.benefits: Improves testability by allowing unit tests of controller functions without Express app setup, enables better code organization for scaling (controllers can be moved to separate files), and makes the route definitions more declarative and readable

suggestions.description: Add centralized error handling middleware to catch unhandled errors and provide consistent error responses
suggestions.benefits: Prevents application crashes from unhandled errors, provides consistent error response format across the application, improves production stability, and enhances debugging in development with error details while keeping production responses secure

suggestions.description: Separate server startup from app definition to improve testability and module reusability
suggestions.benefits: Allows importing the app for testing without automatically starting the server, eliminates port conflicts in test environments, provides flexibility to start server programmatically with custom ports, and follows modern ES modules best practices

refactorings.summary: The file is relatively clean but would benefit from extracting middleware for validation and ID parsing to reduce duplication and improve testability. Adding centralized error handling would significantly improve production stability. Separating route handlers into controller functions and conditionally starting the server would make the code more maintainable and test-friendly.

issues.description: Inconsistent return type between validateTodoText and isValidTodoId functions
issues.suggestion: Both validation functions should return the same shape. Change isValidTodoId to return { valid: boolean, error?: string } for consistency, or document why different return types are used for different validators.

issues.description: Missing JSDoc return type annotation for error property
issues.suggestion: Update JSDoc to use @returns {{ valid: boolean, error?: string }} to properly document the optional error property, matching the actual implementation.

issues.description: Magic number used as constant without explanation
issues.suggestion: Consider adding a comment explaining why 200 characters is the maximum, or make it configurable if business requirements might change.

issues.description: No validation for edge case: Number.isInteger(0)
issues.suggestion: While the current implementation correctly rejects 0 (id > 0), consider adding explicit test coverage or documentation for the zero case to clarify that IDs start at 1.

codeQuality.summary: The code is well-written with proper input validation, type checking, and clear documentation. The main issue is inconsistent return types between the two validation functions, which could lead to confusion for API consumers. The code correctly handles edge cases like trimming whitespace and uses strict type checking, but would benefit from standardizing the validation response format.

untestedPaths.reasoning: The function trims input before checking length, but there's no explicit test for an empty string '' (only whitespace-only '   '). This is a common edge case that should be explicitly verified.
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: test that validateTodoText('') returns { valid: false, error: 'text must not be empty' }

untestedPaths.suggestedTest: test that validateTodoText(null) returns { valid: false, error: 'text must be a string' }

untestedPaths.reasoning: Similar to null, undefined is a common accidental input (e.g., from missing function parameters) and should be explicitly tested.
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: test that validateTodoText(undefined) returns { valid: false, error: 'text must be a string' }

untestedPaths.reasoning: Number.isInteger(null) returns false, but null is a common edge case worth explicitly testing to document behavior.
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: test that isValidTodoId(null) returns false

untestedPaths.reasoning: Number.isInteger(undefined) returns false, but undefined (e.g., from missing parameters) should be explicitly tested.
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: test that isValidTodoId(undefined) returns false

untestedPaths.suggestedTest: test that isValidTodoId(NaN) returns false

untestedPaths.reasoning: Number.isInteger(Infinity) returns false, but testing special numeric values like Infinity documents complete behavior. Low priority as it's an uncommon real-world case.
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: test that isValidTodoId(Infinity) and isValidTodoId(-Infinity) both return false

testCoverage.summary: The validation.js file has strong test coverage with tests/validation.test.js covering all main paths, error conditions, and boundary cases for both exported functions. The major untested path is an empty string without whitespace in validateTodoText(), which should be added as it's a common edge case. Additional edge case tests for null/undefined inputs would improve robustness, though the existing type checks likely handle these correctly.

suggestions.description: Extract magic string error messages into constants for consistency and maintainability
suggestions.benefits: Centralizes error messages for easier maintenance, testing, and potential i18n support. Makes it simple to ensure consistent error messaging across the application.

suggestions.description: Align return type with validateTodoText for consistency - return an object with valid/error structure instead of a boolean
suggestions.benefits: Creates a consistent validation API across all validators, making them composable and easier to use. Provides detailed error messages instead of silent boolean failures, improving debugging and user feedback.

suggestions.description: Add a generic validation result type using JSDoc typedef for better type safety and documentation
suggestions.benefits: Improves type safety and autocomplete in IDEs, reduces duplication in JSDoc comments, and makes the validation contract explicit and reusable across the codebase.

suggestions.description: Extract the trimming logic to make the validation pure and allow testing trimmed values separately
suggestions.benefits: Makes normalization logic explicit and reusable. If normalization rules become more complex (e.g., removing extra spaces, handling special characters), there's a single place to modify. Also improves testability by isolating concerns.

suggestions.description: Make the constant configurable by exporting it, allowing consumers to reference the limit
suggestions.benefits: Allows other modules (like UI components) to reference the same limit for input validation, character counters, or error messages without hardcoding values. Maintains single source of truth.

refactorings.summary: The validation.js file is functionally sound but has several opportunities for improvement. The most impactful changes are standardizing the return type of isValidTodoId to match validateTodoText (creating a consistent API), and extracting error messages into constants for better maintainability. Additional improvements include adding a shared ValidationResult typedef and exporting the MAX_TODO_TEXT_LENGTH constant for reuse across the application.

recommendations.description: Add comprehensive integration tests for src/server.js. All four API endpoints (GET, POST, PATCH, DELETE) lack test coverage for both success and error paths.
Implement rate limiting and payload size limits to protect against DoS and payload attacks. Add helmet for security headers and configure CORS policy.
Add centralized error handling middleware and input validation for ID parameters to prevent application crashes and improve stability.
Add edge case tests for empty strings (without whitespace) and null/undefined inputs in validation functions.
Standardize validation function return types. Change isValidTodoId to return { valid: boolean, error?: string } to match validateTodoText.
Extract middleware for validation and ID parsing to reduce code duplication and improve testability.
Extract route handlers into controller functions and separate server startup logic from app definition for better testability.
Standardize error messages and extract validation error messages into constants for easier maintenance and i18n support.
